base: Exact copy of active Gautama; concepts only, no runtime integration.

prompts.lv2:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: top-down 2D spaceship concept sprite for the Starsector mod Chief Navigator.
Input image 1 is the existing Gautama hull, the identity and rendering-style reference. Preserve its recognizable uneven left shoulder plate, tall central keel, right-side recessed industrial structures, ivory/bone-colored weathered metal, black recessed mechanical ribwork, muted tarnished gray-green details, and sharp native painted sprite texture. Bow remains up. Camera is strict orthographic overhead, zero perspective or tilt. This is an expanded mutated version of the SAME single ship; actual added structure and altered silhouette, not a rescaled copy or a collection of separate ships.
Material is self-assembled machinery: irregular pale plates, structural spars, dark cable bundles, lattices and empty gaps. Menacing and malformed but clearly manufactured. No living flesh, gore, bug carapace, smooth chrome, human architecture, decorative wings, text, labels, borders, background scene, stars, shadows cast on a backdrop, or opaque backdrop. Keep subtle even top-left sprite lighting and restrained contrast matching the reference, without luminous neon or engine flame plumes. One centered whole hull fully visible with clear transparent padding on every side, genuinely transparent background. No clipping.
Primary request: create GAUTAMA LV2, the first mutation after the base. Enlarge the ship through about 25–30% additional structural span and mass around the recognizable original core. Preserve most of the original core and its asymmetric identity. Add two or three irregular clusters of overlapping ivory armor and short outward forks, interwoven dark skeletal struts and cable webs, and some widened machinery cavities. Added growth must feel incremental, plausible nanomachine accretion, not clean symmetrical shipyard design. Preserve visible round mechanical mounting recesses instead of adding large invented cannons. Moderate mutation, not the final monstrous form. Aim for an approximately 800-pixel wide hull on a square 1024-pixel transparent canvas; maintain small-scale painted game-sprite detail, not a cinematic 3D render.
